老年人.en: My parents told me that I need to respect old people.

老年人.zh: 我家里有个老年人突然倒在地上，大概是中风了。
老年人.pinyin: wǒ jiā lǐ yǒu gè lǎo nián rén tū rán dǎo zài dì shàng dà gài shì zhòng fēng le
老年人.en: An elderly person in my family suddenly fell to the ground; he likely suffered a stroke.

准确性.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.

可比.zh: 事情可比他所想的要复杂得多。

族群.en: The Algerians are a hospitable people.

日积月累.en: Putting in effort daily is essential to language learning.

易懂.zh: 这本字典的例句十分浅白易懂。

易懂.en: The examples in this dictionary are easy to understand.

易懂.en: Such manuals should be written in simpler language.

考上.en: He studied hard in order to get into college.

装有.zh: 我找到一个装有几枚古钱币的锅子。
